lines.text: Jeremiah the prophet sends a letter from Jerusalem to the exiles Nebuchadnezzar carried off to Egypt.
Elasah son of Shaphan and Gemariah son of Hilkiah carry the letter, and Zedekiah king of Judah sent them.
The LORD tells the exiles to build houses, plant gardens, have children, and seek the downfall of the city.
The LORD warns the exiles not to be deceived by the prophets and diviners, whom He has not sent.
After seventy years the LORD promises to restore the exiles, who will find Him when they search wholeheartedly.
